blocks.text: We’re a member of the Air Conditioning Contractors of America, the nation’s largest organization of HVAC contractors. Furthermore, our technicians are bonded, insured, and licensed. They have also undergone the training necessary to obtain NATE certification. Our technicians stay up-to-date on advances in AC technology.

Getting an air conditioner replacement is a major step, and some homeowners in Shavano Park may feel they can’t afford it. However, we offer financing through Service Finance Company on approved credit. Let us inspect your current system, be it a central AC, heat pump, or mini-split, and help you determine if a new one is necessary.

There are many reasons why you might want a new air conditioner. Perhaps your current system is over 10 years old, in which case it’s nearing the end of its life span. Perhaps it has a bad compressor or another costly issue, in which case replacement may be cheaper in the long run.

After we agree that a new AC installation is the way to go, we’ll perform a load calculation of your Shavano Park property. This means taking into account your property’s size and rate of heat loss. We can even present you with options in the appropriate size. We deal mostly with American Standard products, but we know how to install all makes and models.

The installation process will be hassle-free. Since our technicians are highly trained, you won’t have to worry about a thing. They will treat your property with respect at all times, cleaning up once the job is done. Everything will be done according to factory specifications.

Turn to Rosenberg Plumbing & Air when you need an air conditioner replacement in Shavano Park. We keep our schedule flexible, and we always make honest recommendations.
